description: Pub. 537 (2025), Sale and Later Disposition, Example 1: farmland sold to your child for $500,000 in five annual payments, installment sale basis $250,000, gross profit percentage 50%. $100,000 received in 2024; in 2025 the child pays $100,000 and resells for $600,000. 'Lesser of ... $500,000 Subtract: Sum of payments ... − 200,000 Amount treated as received because of second disposition $300,000 Add: Payment ... + 100,000 ... × 0.50 Installment sale income for 2025 $200,000' — Part II line 24 $50,000 plus Part III line 35 $150,000, § 1231 gain on Form 4797 line 4.
